observations: Assembly view shows widened tray beside straight frame cheeks, with original battery envelope and no separate inward screw-retention lands.
Isolated Load_Frame view confirms continuous flat inner side faces above the existing lower bearing ledges; lower ledges retain recessed drive fixing holes.
Isolated Battery_Tray view shows a single open tray with continuous side rails, two strap slots and lateral retention bores; no new attachment ears or parts.
limits: Images supplement actual-solid checks; contact pressure, printed sliding fit, insert strength and loaded vibration remain untested. 0.3 mm each-side clearance is a trial parameter, not a machine-independent fit.
